summary: The documentation plan matches the supplied ODT inventory, orders work by complexity, preserves upstream ownership, and includes UI implementation and acceptance for configurable features.
findings: Seven phases distinguish parser diagnostics, scalar properties, structural markers, font/page resources, canonical tables, and whole-document acceptance; each feature phase specifies semantic and UI gates.
The plan treats the source ODT as private and does not copy its text or embedded assets.
evidence_refs: ap doctor: OK with pre-existing warnings
residual_risks: Exact console-message counts require phase 0 runtime capture; this plan uses a read-only static XML inventory.
